oneOf.description: An operation that needs this block must have the exact interpreter.

Interpretation is optional; an unknown payload is still preserved.

SourceContextFactOrigin.description:

Human project decisions remain in the project's independent revision owner.

TextRange.description: Half-open offsets into one exact string, never between different strings.
